note: Invented products and invented findings, drawn in the real extension panel (see capture.mjs). Nothing here assesses a real brand. `products` are the four pictures in the gallery; `research` is the one product no catalog knows; `shortlist` is what sits beside the first product in the Compare picture.

claims.title: Battery range drops by a third after two winters
claims.body: Owners of the 2022 model report a usable range about a third lower after two winters of outdoor storage. The pack ages faster when it is left cold and full.
claims.advice: Ask for the charge-cycle count and the range on the last ride.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: Mine does 40 km now, it did 60 when I bought it, and it lived in the shed.

claims.title: Motor cuts out after rain
claims.body: Water gets into the controller plug under the rear rack. The motor stops until the plug dries.
claims.advice: Check the plug under the rack for green corrosion.

sources.title: Repair thread
sources.quote: Cut out twice in the wet. The plug under the rack was full of water.

claims.title: Brake pads are a six-month item
claims.body: The service manual calls for new pads every six months of daily commuting. Original pads on a two-year-old bike mean the brakes were not serviced.
claims.advice: Ask which pads are on it and when the brakes were last bled.

sources.title: Service manual
sources.quote: Replace the pads every six months under daily use.

claims.title: Display shows a sensor error on cold starts
claims.body: The screen flags a speed-sensor error below freezing. It clears after a few minutes.

claims.title: Side-brush motor fails after about eight months
claims.body: Owners report the side brush stopping, then a grinding noise from the motor housing, after roughly eight months of daily runs.
claims.advice: Ask whether a spare brush assembly is sold, and what it costs.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: Month eight, the side brush just stopped. The motor grinds when I spin it by hand.

claims.title: Schedules need a cloud account
claims.body: No-go zones and schedules can only be set in the app, which asks you to sign in. Without an account the robot only cleans on demand.
claims.advice: Check what the app asks for before you rely on the schedule.

sources.title: User manual
sources.quote: Sign in to the app to create a schedule or draw a no-go zone.

claims.title: Stuck on thresholds above 1.5 cm
claims.body: The robot climbs low door rails but stalls on higher ones, and some units keep trying until the battery is flat.
claims.advice: Measure your highest threshold before you buy.

sources.title: Review notes
sources.quote: Fine on the rugs, stranded on the bathroom door rail every time.

claims.title: Dustbin lid pops open on bumps
claims.body: The lid latch is loose on some units and the bin empties itself over the first rug.

claims.title: Fingerprint sensor stops after a screen repair
claims.body: A replacement screen that is not matched to the phone can switch off the fingerprint sensor for good. Owners report it after repairs at independent shops.
claims.advice: Ask whether the screen was ever replaced, and test the sensor yourself.

sources.title: Repair thread
sources.quote: New screen fitted, and the fingerprint sensor has never worked since.

claims.title: Battery health falls below 80% within two years
claims.body: The maker rates the battery for 500 full charges down to 80%. A phone sold at two years, charged daily, is probably near that line.
claims.advice: Open the battery health screen and ask for a photo of it.

sources.title: Maker's support page
sources.quote: Rated to keep 80% of its capacity at 500 full charge cycles.

claims.title: Water resistance is gone after any repair
claims.body: The seal is glued, and few repairs restore it. A phone that has been opened is splash-proof at best.
claims.advice: Ask if the case has been opened, and look for gaps along the frame.

sources.title: Teardown notes
sources.quote: The adhesive seal does not survive the opening and shops rarely replace it.

claims.title: Speaker crackles at full volume
claims.body: A crackle at the top of the volume range, mostly on speech. A software update reduces it.

claims.title: Drum bearing grows loud after two years
claims.body: Owners report a rumble on the spin cycle from about the second year. The bearing is welded into the tub, so the repair costs close to a new machine.
claims.advice: Ask for its age, and run a spin cycle if you can hear one.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: Year two, a rumble on every spin. The repairman quoted nearly the price of a new one.

claims.title: Door seal grows mould if the door stays shut
claims.body: The manual asks you to leave the door open after each wash. Left shut, the seal turns black and starts to smell.
claims.advice: Look under the door seal for dark spots.

sources.title: User manual
sources.quote: Leave the door ajar after every wash to let the seal dry.

claims.title: Drain pump blocks with coins and hair
claims.body: The filter sits behind a low flap and the pump jams easily. A blocked pump leaves water in the drum.
claims.advice: Find the filter before you buy; it should open without tools.

sources.title: Repair guide
sources.quote: Filter behind the bottom flap, packed with hair and a coin.

claims.title: Time left jumps during the wash
claims.body: The countdown stalls and then skips ahead while the machine balances the load. It finishes on time.

claims.title: Battery contacts overheat under heavy load
claims.body: Owners report the pack contacts burning after long runs in masonry. The pack housing warps and no longer clicks into the drill.
claims.advice: Look at the pack contacts for burn marks, and check the pack still clicks in.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: An afternoon in concrete and the contacts were black. The pack will not seat any more.

claims.title: Chuck slips under hard load
claims.body: The keyless chuck loosens in hard materials and the bit spins free. Tightening by hand is not enough.
claims.advice: Clamp a large bit and pull hard to see whether it holds.

sources.title: Review notes
sources.quote: The chuck lets go of 10 mm bits in steel. I went back to a keyed one.

claims.title: Charger fits only the same battery generation
claims.body: Packs from the older range do not charge on this charger, and the new pack does not fit older tools.
claims.advice: Ask which batteries and tools come with it, and whether they match.

sources.title: Maker's compatibility chart
sources.quote: Packs marked 2019 or earlier are not compatible with this charger.

claims.title: Work light switches off after ten seconds
claims.body: The LED goes out on its own, and the delay cannot be changed.

claims.title: Basket coating flakes after a year
claims.body: The non-stick layer lifts at the corners of the basket after about a year of weekly use.
claims.advice: Look closely at the basket corners and ask whether a spare is sold.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: The coating is peeling off the corners of the basket after twelve months.

claims.title: Handle gets hot on long cooks
claims.body: The handle warms through after twenty minutes at high heat. It is too hot to grip bare-handed on some units.
claims.advice: Ask whether an oven glove is needed for long cooks.

sources.title: Review notes
sources.quote: After 25 minutes the handle is too hot to hold without a glove.

claims.title: The beeper cannot be turned off
claims.body: A loud beep ends every cook, and the menu has no way to silence it.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: No setting for the beep. It wakes the whole house.
